Schwoz works to create an antivirus to stop an evil plan; Kid Danger and Captain Man battle a villain; Kid Danger's heroism is put to the ultimate test as they fight to save the world.
When the Knight Squad's archenemy, Ryker, is unleashed on Swellview, Kid Danger and Captain Man take him down to Burger Castle, only to be tricked into joining forces with the villain.

Taylor and the boys receive a mysterious message after a pink aurora appears above Rock Island. As the boys begin to investigate the strange occurrence, they begin to realise that the message came from their future selves.
Taylor accidentally creates a clone of herself, who ends up causing a lot of trouble.
It's the Chahuta's chilli eating contest, and soon it's revealed Marcel's a cheat. When Hope takes Gran Gran's special ladle to the park to play, it ends up at Professor Lopez's archaeological dig.
Stan claims to have a real Marsupilami appearing in a show he's putting on, but it's a fake robot. Acu thinks a fish-loving alien is in town, and Mica offers to help him track it down.
Papa Smurf is excited to pick the magic Sarsaparilla plant, but he's not the only one hunting for the rare plant.
Smurfette accidentally loses the Smurf Village in a bet and must carefully try to win it back.
Bubble goes on an adventure with Firefly. Gargamel creates a switch that can turn off all the lights so that he can find the Smurf village.
Squidward and Plankton come together to make their very own stage play where SpongeBob is cast as the villain; Sandy decides to give herself gills so she can truly experience Bikini Bottom.
Mr Krabs and Plankton must cooperate after being shipwrecked on a desert island. SpongeBob and Squidina attempt to start a rival Captain Quasar fan club after Bubble Bass kicks them out.

Rock, Paper, and Scissors try to maintain their tradition of seeing every Moonami film on opening day; the trio ends up before a spider judge and jury for attempting to squish a spider in their apartment.

Scissors thinks he's finally discovered his thing when he joins forces with the sleep-themed villain Dreamscape. Rock is sick and can't lead the Robo Car Wash in the Car Wash Nationals dance competition, leaving it to Paper and Scissors.
Sonic meets his match in Chaos Sonic, a robot version of himself designed to never fail. Meanwhile, the Chaos Council decides to expand their empire.
The key to reassembling the Paradox Prism lies in one of the Shatterspaces. But Nine and Sonic must find a portal to safely transport the Shards there.
When a meteor unleashes a virus that turns zoo animals into zombies, a mountain lion and a wolf lead a team of survivors to save the day.
Max and Phoebe bring Chloe on an undercover mission in a new town, so she can experience life as a normal kid.

A training accident makes Chloe's powers faulty. Max tries to cure her and gets a misleading positive result, so she goes to a party, but his treatment actually creates brand-new powers Chloe can't control.
Activity in a dormant super volcano under Swellview makes Henry and Ray think the world is ending. Piper is convinced she has a gluten intolerance.
Accompanied by Diego and Boots, Dora embarks on her most daring adventure yet as she treks through the jungles of the Amazon to find an ancient treasure that grants a magical wish.
An accident-prone yellow sea sponge, who works in a fast-food restaurant, has adventures with his friends in the underwater city of Bikini Bottom.

In an attempt to get out of the dentist, Lily insists on a summer celebration of the fall holiday Chuseok. When Will accidentally befriends an annoying man, his sorry attempts at a break-up make things painfully awkward for the whole family.

Min tries to avoid the usual Woori World chaos, but when the family splits up they all get lost in their own fiascos. Jack's mission to find the rare DVD sequel of his favourite movie leads him to the mysterious Collector.
Baby Corp has been dismantled, but that doesn't stop Boss Baby from rallying to reunite his employees; Tim spends one last day with Danny.
With nappies piling up in the Templetons' basement, Boss Baby hatches a plan to break into Baby Corp, kick out his enemies and take his business back.

Max bets Phoebe she can't turn off being a superhero and go on a normal date; Chloe helps Phoebe do well on the date, but Max tries to sabotage by crying wolf; suddenly, a real supervillain emerges and puts Max and Chloe in serious danger.
Children, Fantasy, Action, Adventure, Comedy, Crime drama
Cherry visits and Max discovers Phoebe never took her sparkle power away. Phoebe promises to do so and has a girls' night with Cherry while Max hosts Jinx.
SpongeBob works the grill at the toughest joint in town; Karen looks after Spot while Plankton goes out of town.
The Institute is shutting down and Taylor and Lila are told they're moving away from Rock Island, which leads to one last adventure and a shocking revelation from Raquel.
Sal and Anika are left empty-handed and must find a different way to outwit their enemy. Back in the forest, Oliver decides to take matters into his own hands.
With the eclipse rapidly approaching and the final riddle solved, the kids must put their heads together and figure out how to stop their enemy and get to the treasure first.
The Sibunas fail to wake Frobisher and are trapped in the crypt with the adults on the warpath. Can Patricia rescue her friends? Jerome sweats as Mara and Willow get closer.
Victor confiscates KT's key and when Jerome begs Patricia for a favour she strikes a deal. The Sibunas discover that the adults have special plans. How will they stop them?
When a local celebrity chef comes to Junk-N-Stuff to do his live show, Kid Danger and Captain Man are forced to hike a half a mile up the Man Stairs so they can be on the show.

After acting too confident before a fight, Kid Danger and Captain Man are sprayed with Flabber Gas, making them powerless to defeat a new villain in Swellview. Schwoz puts the heroes in Exo-Suits which Charlotte and Jasper control.
It's time for Mapleview to elect their school president. Dimitri wants to run and enlists the help of Julie, who loves his ideas for change within their school.
Taylor is transported to an alternate version of Rock Island where she doesn't exist, and her friends don't know her.

The gang find a dinosaur fossil at the beach, and it leads to the entire beach being turned into a dig site. While Taylor, Meesha and Lila work on the fossil, Ellis and Nori help out at the South Section.

Tess finds an old Ruybosch family tree and realises it is marked with the same crown symbol. Jenny helps Sal investigate his hacker and a comic book publisher approaches Jake with an interesting offer.
The kids think Lucia framed Erik and decide to frame her back by planting a vase in her house. But the plan goes awry, and they must work to avoid getting caught.

The kids find evidence that could prove Erik's innocence, but someone hacks into Sal's computer and erases the footage. Max realises there is something strange about how his birth parents tracked him down.
Evie's stepmum, Lucia, tries to take her back. The Hunters try to track down info on Lucia and visit Evie's old neighbourhood, where they meet tech-loving Jennie.
Coach Dobbins challenges Miss Smith and her ragtag team of outcasts to a baseball game. Dave has a problem when each of the Chipettes wants him to be their date to the Father Daughter Dance.

When Miss Miller gets robbed, Eleanor and Theodore promise to find the culprit and bring them to justice. Alvin begrudgingly agrees to teach Miss Smith guitar, but she won't reveal why she so desperately needs to learn.

Brittany's dream of being a fashion designer turns into a nightmare when she gets a job and her ideas are stolen. Alvin suspects Dave of being a local bank robber when Dave starts acting suspiciously and giving the boys gifts.
After squabbling with his brothers, Alvin convinces Dave to give him his own room, but soon realises living alone isn't what it's cracked up to be.
It's the big Bake-Off, and Eleanor has prepared her signature cake. Brittany and Alvin eat the cake without knowing its importance. Can they re-make the cake in time?
When Alvin makes fun of Simon's magic act, Simon challenges him to a magic duel.
Alvin dresses Theodore up like a baby in order to impress the girl of his dreams.

Simon's experiment of how plants respond to positive or negative feedback creates a monster, and it's growing. Brittany's fear of bees turns into admiration when she's shrunk down to their size and experiences life as a bee.

Alvin bets Bo Carter that alien life exists and only has a week to prove it or suffer embarrassing consequences. Brittany's furious when she thinks Alvin has been writing on her blog and vows to get him back.

When the boys accidentally break Dave's new flat screen TV. they decide to become fugitives on the lam. Jeanette and Eleanor act as Sherlock Holmes and Watson when Theodore's teddy bear mysteriously disappears.

Alvin thinks he's losing his mind when Simon goes missing and no one else even remembers who Simon is. When the girls at school cast votes for the cutest chipmunk on the bathroom wall, Alvin worries about the results.

Theodore is stuck taking care of Miss Croner's cats during a week that Dave wants the boys to focus only on school. The Chipettes challenge the Chipmunks to go three hours without their favourite things.

Jeanette decides to plant a garden on the school grounds, but Bo Carter manages to install vending machines instead. When Alvin finds a treasure map in Miss Croner's basement, the chipmunks set off in search of lost treasure.

When Brittany is hurt before a major school event, Jeanette fills in as the Principal's assistant. When Bocarter's father helps him with his class project, Alvin enlists Dave's help, locking the families in a heated competition.

Theodore gives Dave an ugly handmade vest for his birthday and insists he wear it to an upcoming business meeting. When Theodore finds a winning lottery ticket, everyone has their own ideas on how the money should be spent.

Dave gets temporary amnesia, so the boys trick him into letting them skip school and go on a ski trip instead. Theodore becomes obsessed with cleanliness after a speaker at school talks to the class about the danger of germs.

When Alvin thinks Theodore's teddy bear can tell the future, Alvin goes all out to make Talking Teddy his friend. Alvin lies to Theodore about a fake holiday to get out of chores, so Dave forces Alvin to make the holiday real.

When Theodore's teddy bear, Talking Teddy, gets bear-napped, the boys work with Officer Dangus to get him back. When Alvin starts stealing the morning paper to sell at school, Dave blames the paperboy and refuses to pay up.
Theodore must prove he's got the right stuff when the Chipmunks and Chipettes head off to space camp. Theodore burns his tongue on some super-hot chocolate and loses his sense of taste.
Dave gets a parenting app to help supervise the Chipmunks. Alvin, Simon and the Chipettes give Theodore conflicting dating advice when they believe he has a crush on a girl.
Dave worries that the Chipmunks have become addicted to a video game. A grounded Alvin begs Theodore to buy him a limited edition skateboard.

In order to get Theodore to do his bidding, Alvin tells him that he has secret powers and can turn rubbish into candy; when the chipmunks find a baby bird that has fallen from its nest, Alvin is reluctant to get too attached.
The Chipmunks take in a stray dog, but have to keep the puppy hidden from Dave, who won't allow pets. Theodore orders a dragon egg in the hopes of it hatching into a real dragon.

When the Principal's cat goes missing, Theodore gives her a music box. When Dave discovers his Grandma's music box is missing, he calls the police. Theodore's been mistakenly mailed off in a box. Now Simon and Alvin have to get him home.

Alvin and Brittany give wildly differing versions of why the fire alarm went off at the school to Miss Smith. Convinced a zombie invasion is imminent, Alvin and Theodore go all out in an attempt to protect their loved ones.
Miss Croner attempts to help Theodore discover his true calling in life. Jeanette is suddenly the clumsiest person on the planet.
Theodore gets roped into doing Alvin's babysitting job with a spoiled four-year-old. Kevin agrees to be Alvin's assistant to get closer to the music industry, but ends up running errands instead.

When Theodore discovers Alvin and Simon have a secret club, he promises not to tell anyone if they let him join. Dave promises to take Alvin to a water park if he gets a good grade on his test, but then a crow steals it.

The Chipmunks and Chipettes compete in a dodgeball tournament but no-one expects Theo to be their secret weapon. The Chipmunks find a shack that magically fills with toys and games, but is it magic or something more sinister?

When Theodore mistakenly thinks he's the oldest brother, he tries to be a better role model for Alvin and Simon. Alvin tricks Theodore into believing he's great at mini golf, which backfires when Theo signs up for a tournament.
Coach Dobbins kicks Cheesy and Theodore off the track team for being slow.

While training for a TV baking competition with Eleanor, Theodore develops an allergy to an unknown ingredient. // After a lice outbreak that closes the school, Dave sets up a classroom in the house acting as their teacher.

When Derek overhears that Alvin and his brothers are alone for the weekend, he plans a wild party at their house. Theodore is hit by lightning and believes he's like his comic book hero, until he's told he's actually a villain.
After getting detention again, Alvin's convinced Dave will drive him to the desert and abandon him there; Alvin and Theodore play a seemingly innocent game, which leads to unexpected consequences.
Alvin's too short to ride a new amusement park ride; while on a ski trip, Alvin convinces Theodore there's a Yeti nearby.
Dave has a writer's block. Alvin puts a curse on Theodore.
Alvin books the band at a birthday party only to discover they've been booked for the petting zoo as pets; Theodore invents an imaginary friend.

To keep a planned holiday, the boys do all they can to stop Dave from learning that Alvin has summer school; when Theodore drops a puzzle piece down a floor vent, he gets trapped inside while trying to fish it out.

When Alvin insists on taking over the drums from Theodore, Theodore fights back by stealing Alvin's persona. As Theodore is perfecting a pancake recipe, Alvin plays a trick by pouring burping powder in his next batch.
Dave sets down a very strict study schedule when Alvin blames him for his poor grades. Theodore must pose as a dog after the chipmunks accidentally shave the fur off a dog Miss Miller is watching.
Theodore is passed over when Alvin and Eleanor train as lifeguards; Miss Croner's cherries are lost.

The Munks help a world-famous runner design a pair of prosthetic legs for a race she's set to run in. Theodore embarks on a quest to find one thing he can do better than Simon, and he quickly realises it won't be easy.

Alvin invites Dave's old high school rival to an elaborate dinner to prove to him that Dave is a huge success. The Chipmunks can't wait to go on a World tour until Theodore and Alvin realise what they'll be leaving behind.
Terry is asked to get rid of some squatters, leading Arthur to dream of a future as a property developer.
Gary takes Michael out in his pram, and they are nearly killed by a bomb. When he awakes in the present day, Gary is horrified to discover that Michael has travelled in time, as well.
When Chrissy is given two tickets for a Frank Sinatra concert, she becomes very popular. Jo offers to make her bed and Robin says he'll do anything she wants.
Kenny Everett welcomes Dire Straits and Lionel Blair for music, laughter and more.
The best music from the 1960s and some forgotten gems. The soundtrack to New Year's Day.
News, interviews and features for Scotland from the last week.
Movie spin-off from the popular TV sitcom in which teacher Bernard Hedges takes troublesome class 5C to a holiday camp with inevitably comic and disastrous results.

Rigsby has been busy trying to attract Miss Jones' attentions. Meanwhile, Miss Jones has been busy trying to attract Philip's attentions. During a chat with the boys, Rigsby is told that Philip has ten wives, and that he is seen as a God in his own country. Rigsby is somewhat sceptical and demands proof of Philip's powers. Philip claims he can make something appear, and so performs a small ritual.
Rigsby gets all dressed up to take Miss Jones out for her birthday dinner.
Rigsby is given some advice from Alan and Philip, as well as some tablets to calm his nerves in his amorous pursuit of Miss Jones.
A tough new tenant plays his stereo very loud and Rigsby is afraid to ask him to keep it down.
Rigsby rushes to protect Ruth after she sees a prowler in her room, but soon it's the chivalrous Rigsby who needs protecting.
Rigsby drums up support for his own candidate as the local elections get under way.

Sharon is back living in her council flat and Tracey is still in Chigwell with younger son Travis but what has become of Dorien? What can bring the sisters back together, and who else might return to the nest?
Sharon finds that looking after Dorien's every wish is a full-time job and with money tight, Sharon and Tracey take Dorien's designer clothes to a car boot sale to raise funds.

Money and space are still tight and Tracey cannot ignore the fact that Garth and Marcie are not getting any quality time together, so it has to be all change in the bedrooms again to give them some space.
The ladies each get romantically involved with three very different men, while Travis faces some issues in his own love life.
Tracey becomes self-conscious about her appearance and has Botox, Travis has a tattoo to impress a girl at school and Sharon looks as if she'll need a hearing aid.
Chewing gum proves to be a problem for Mrs. Slocombe's cat; Captain Peacock discovers an old pistol in a drawer.
The staff at Millstone is asked to provide a cricket team for the village match.
Mrs. Slocombe's ex-husband, missing for 42 years, suddenly shows up as a guest at the manor.
Strange things begin to happen after a chunk of fallen plaster reveals the petrified remains of a cat.
A group of Mongolian businessmen expect an exhibition of British culture, forcing the staff to come up with an ingenious plan.
Mr. Rumbold feels that his authority is being undermined by the staff.
Exploring renowned Ulster-Scots through historical objects and the stories behind them.
Created by two Belfast businesswomen, the show explores real-life experiences of raising twins, family dynamics, adolescent life, and parenting.
Joyce asks Sir Henry to step in while she is at the conference in Barcelona, and Les has asked Neville from the Geordie Bar to cover for him.

As a member of the PTA, Mimi demands respect, but when the teachers threaten to quit over the return of a notorious troublemaker and Mimi is quick to dole out advice, Headmaster Banbury couldn't care less. When Mimi hears that the school will be failed by School Inspector Edward Clayhill she decides to save the day with the help of the Chatsworthians. Meanwhile, Frank discovers an unexpected perk of being school caretaker.
Phoebe finds living in the West End difficult when the butcher proves to be a snob, though Noel Coward does his best to help. Yvonne puts Gary on the guest list for a Downing Street party.
An old adversary's car mysteriously disappears while Terry is minding it.
Come prepared, as those vocal cords are going to see a lot of action with three nostalgic hours spent with Pat Sharp's 70s house party. All gatecrashers welcome!
From the era of Glam Rock, New Wave & Disco - it's all the party hits from just 1 decade - the 1970s! Platform boots & flares at the ready?
From the era of Glam Rock, New Wave & Disco - it's all the hits from just 1 decade - the 1970s! Platform boots & flares at the ready?
From a 'Horse With No Name' to a 'Dog Named Boo' - 12 songs about animals, or by artists with animal connections. Pretty contrived but quite good fun.
The voice of many people's childhood, Derek Griffiths, presents 40 of those tunes people pestered their parents to buy, all top pop moments that still bring a smile and happy memories of school days.
Including 10 million sellers back when it was still a rare achievement! These are the 20 biggest songs of the decade with Julie Covington, David Soul, ABBA, Queen, Blondie and Wings.
From the 'Top of the World' to Argentina, via Bangor, Babylon, Barbados, Cuba, Copacabana, and Hong Kong, a wander around the world in song titles.
Playing quite simply the biggest hits from the biggest pop act of the 70s: ABBA.
Back in the day, being a woman in a macho world of pop meant you had to fight so much harder! So let's celebrate with those who made their mark from Annie and Elkie to Kim and Kate.
We're grooving back to the swinging 60s for classic videos, legendary artists & enough flower power to upset your local florist.
5 hours of flashbacks from the swinging 60s! Including Johnny Cash, Sam Cooke, The Kinks, Lulu, The Beach Boys, The Beatles, The Troggs, Bob Dylan, The Rolling Stones & Elvis.
Who better to present a definitive countdown of 80s synthpop classics than OMD frontman Andy McCluskey? From Kraftwerk, Ultravox & Gary Numan to New Order, Yazoo and Pet Shop Boys.
It's the weekend, and we're showing out! Classic pop that has stood the test of time.
Lush movie love songs with that extra dose of emotion. Warning, expect a bit of Phil Collins.
From the decade that invented the power ballad - non-stop love songs, back to back.
Mark Goodier with a definitive countdown of the 100 biggest acts of the 80s - compiled using record sales, concert tickets, awards & more - from the UK, the USA & around the world!
Dramatic storylines, big dance routines, neon lights and iconic fashions: these are the classic music videos that made the 80s!
The 5 years from '77 to '81 was possibly the most exciting and vibrant time to be a teenager and Clare Grogan was there - buying the records, seeing the bands and wearing the t-shirts!
The smooth laid-back sounds influenced by the US West Coast. With Toto, Christopher Cross, Hall & Oates, George Benson and Michael McDonald.
It's October, and here in full for Halloween season - it's 'Thriller'!
The playlist features a selection of hair-raising hits from the eighties.
Famous for his big hair, less famous for his tunes: Pat Sharp is back with a countdown of classic 80s songs accompanied by dodgy 80s hair-don'ts!
30 years & 4 hours of classic rock bands, in order from 1965-1995! Expect to see The Stones, The Who, Joan Jett, Aerosmith, AC/DC, Queen, Genesis & The Beatles.
Rounding off the week with rock classics and anthems! We guarantee AC/DC, Nirvana, Queen, Meat Loaf, Bon Jovi & much more!
From 1983 to 2000 – 60 minutes of the biggest rock songs from U2!
Nicky Horne's definitive 30 best British rock tracks from across the decades. Featuring Queen, Yes, Deep Purple, Motörhead, The Sex Pistols but who is the very best of British?
In many people's opinion Queen are the greatest British band in the world! Sit back and enjoy as we play their biggest hits back to back!
The legendary frontman of rock icons Deep Purple has handpicked 25 of the finest bands from the past six decades. It's classics all the way, so crank it up!
To celebrate the launch of NOW Rock TV, we've compiled a brand-new classic 101, celebrating 5 decades of rock - from the 60s to the 00s. Which guitar legends will be at number 1?
Turn it up to 11 for the finest rock anthems, featuring Kings of Leon, The Killers, Green Day, Biffy Clyro, and the Foo Fighters!
These are the legendary rock stars that made the 80s! Expect Meat Loaf, Bonnie Tyler, Queen, Bon Jovi, AC/DC, Iron Maiden & loads more!
Die Talkshow beschäftigt sich mit den spannendsten und wichtigsten Ereignissen des Tages.
Das innovative Magazin widmet sich dem wichtigen Thema "Tierschutz in Österreich".
Die Gäste und Experten unterhalten sich über interessante Themen und aktuelle Gesundheitsaspekte.

Monk ist ein frustrierter Romanautor, der keine Lust mehr auf das Establishment hat, das von schwarzer Unterhaltung profitiert, die sich auf müde und beleidigende Metaphern stützt. Infolgedessen beschließt er unter einem Pseudonym ein ausgefallenes Buch zu schreiben. Auf diese Weise wird er immer mehr in das Zentrum der Heuchelei und des Wahnsinns getrieben, das er bisher eigentlich verachtet hat.

Samantha Stobbart ist frisch in einer neuen Beziehung - doch die bevorstehende Gefängnisentlassung ihres gewaltbereiten Ex-Freundes Raoul Moat macht sie zunehmend nervös. Als der von Samanthas Romanze erfährt, begeht er ein grauenhaftes Verbrechen.

Raoul Moats Angriff auf David Rathband hat katastrophale Folgen. In einem Brief erhöht der Flüchtige die Drohungen gegen die Polizei. Die wiederum kommt Moat zwar allmählich auf die Spur, doch er schafft es erneut, zu entkommen.

Als die Ereignisse eine gleichermaßen unerwartete wie schockierende Wendung nehmen, muss die Polizei versuchen, die angespannte Situation zu entschärfen. In dem kleinen Dorf Rothbury findet die nervenaufreibende Jagd auf Raoul Moat endlich ein Ende.

Scott bestellt Kaffee mit Kuhmilch, Ellen ist offen für neue Teesorten. Einmal die Woche treffen sie sich in einem hippen Café. Die beiden Best Ager sind zwar seit Jahrzehnten verheiratet, leben aber getrennt. Mit einer Paartherapie will Ellen ihre zerbrochene Ehe aufarbeiten. Doch während Scott die Kluft zwischen ihnen schließen möchte, stehen bei ihr die Zeichen auf Trennung. Ellen ist seit Monaten bei den Quäkern und auf dem Weg in ein neues Leben.

Als die Fluggesellschaft die Angehörigen zur Trauerfeier einlädt, nehmen auch Thomas Wintersperger und seine Frau Sonja daran teil, um Abschied von ihrer Tochter Anna zu nehmen. Weil er ihr nahe bleiben möchte, kauft Thomas einen heruntergekommenen Krämerladen in der Nähe der Unfallstelle und baut ihn zu einer Kneipe aus. Seine Frau zeigt kein Verständnis dafür. Das Paar geht zunächst getrennte Wege. Langsam belebt die Kneipe den verschlafenen Hafen und bringt Bewegung ins Dorf.

Sylvia, die die heimische Küche immer wieder als Friseursalon nutzt, hat ihrer Schwester Klara eine Frisur verpasst, zu der Lena nur der Vergleich mit ihrer Lieblingspuppe einfällt. Doch der entsetzten Klara bleibt keine Zeit für Korrekturen. Sie muss schleunigst ins Büro. Ihre Kollegen sind bei Frau Müller-Dietz im Abteilungsmeeting, da erscheint Hauptkommissar Walter Stichling von der Magdeburger Polizeidirektion im Revier. Gernot Stahlmann, ein prominenter Unternehmer, sei ermordet worden.

Klara Degen feiert zusammen mit Sylvia, Lena und ihren Kollegen das alljährliche Vereinsfest des Polizeisportvereins. Eine Band spielt auf. Frontmann Jens Riebel war einst Klaras große Jugendliebe. Noch immer scheint es zwischen den beiden zu knistern. Hauptkommissar Paul Kleinert registriert die gegenseitigen Blicke der beiden mit gemischten Gefühlen. Da besteigt Evelyn Brenner, eine ehemalige Backgroundsängerin und Exfreundin von Jens, die Bühne und verpasst ihm eine Ohrfeige.

Eine Teilnehmerin der bevorstehenden Wahl zur Miss Harz wird während der Generalprobe tot in ihrer Garderobe aufgefunden. Ausgerechnet Klara Degens Schwester Sylvia hat die Leiche entdeckt und die Polizei alarmiert. Deshalb nimmt Hauptkommissar Kleinert, der zusammen mit Kollege Ollenhauer zum Tatort eilt, ausnahmsweise auch Klara mit, damit sie sich um die geschockte Sylvia kümmern kann. Marie Gäbler, Favoritin der Miss-Wahl, wurde vermutlich vergiftet.

Als Hauptkommissar Paul Kleinert zufällig seiner Sekretärin Klara Degen vor einem Kino begegnet und sich schon auf einen gemeinsamen Abend freut, wird er zum Fundort einer Frauenleiche gerufen. Am Fuße eines Steilhangs liegt Gaby König, nur mit Wanderschuhen bekleidet. Für Kleinert sieht es nach einem Unfall aus. Vermutlich ist sie vom bei FKK-Anhängern beliebten Naturistenstieg abgekommen und gestürzt.

Hauptkommissar Paul Kleinert steckt in Gewissensnöten. Seiner Mutter, die in Magdeburg lebt, wurde die Handtasche geraubt und nun fordert sie energisch, er müsse die Ermittlungen aufnehmen. Kleinert schickt Wolter zum Einsatz nach Magdeburg.

Peggy March - Mit 15 hatte sie ihren ersten Hit in den US-Hitparaden. 1965 war `Mit 17 hat man noch Träume' ihr erster großer Erfolg in Deutschland. Von da an war ihr auch der internationale Durchbruch gelungen. Sie sang Lieder in neun verschiedenen Sprachen und reiste auf Tourneen durch die ganze Welt.

Im Büro wartet ein überraschendes Wiedersehen auf Hanno: seine Jugendliebe Susanne Kramer, eine erfolgreiche Schönheitschirurgin. Sie möchte nach 25 Ehejahren eine saubere Trennung von ihrem Gatten Oliver. Es beginnt jedoch ein Rosenkrieg.

Das beschauliche Familienleben des traditionsbewussten Ehepaars Claude und Marie Verneuil gerät mächtig durcheinander, als drei ihrer Töchter ausgerechnet mit einem Muslim, einem Juden und einem Chinesen den Bund der Ehe schließen. Claude und Maries Hoffnungen auf eine kirchliche Hochzeit ruhen nun auf der jüngsten Tochter Laure, die gerade einen echten französischen Katholiken kennengelernt hat. Doch als sie dem schwarzen Charles gegenüberstehen, reißt ihnen endgültig der Geduldsfaden.

Amandas Vater versucht, sie zur Heirat mit Ditmar zu zwingen. Im Gegenzug würde er Morten bei der Polizei entlasten. Jedoch hat Amandas kleine Schwester ebenfalls ein Wörtchen mitzureden. Auch Max ist alles andere als begeistert von der Hochzeit.

Zehn Jahre nach seiner Abreise nach Amerika kehrt Herr Andersens Sohn Paul zurück, um das Erbe seines Vaters mit Stiefmutter Molly zu regeln. Das Überleben des Hotels steht dabei auf dem Spiel. Amanda lernt derweil Dietmars Vorlieben kennen.

Molly Andersen steht unter Druck, das Hotel zu verkaufen. Lydia und Vera versuchen derweil Herrn Andersen zu kontaktieren. Und plötzlich taucht auch Morten wieder auf. Einige weibliche Gäste machen indes ohne ihre Männer einen Ausflug nach Skagen.

Der Kaufmann Damgaard zieht seinen Kredit an Molly zurück. Er möchte das Hotel selber kaufen und seine Frau soll es führen. Stimmt Molly dem Deal zu? Morten kauft sich unterdessen ein Motorrad und Adam hat endlich geheiratet.

Die Saison neigt sich dem Ende zu und die Gäste bereiten sich auf ihre Abreise vor. Die Polizei sucht bei Morten nach einem Schmuggler. Adam taucht auf. Für viele Gäste und Angestellte bahnt sich der Moment der Wahrheit an.

Die junge Elinor Carlisle wird des Mordes an ihrer Tante und ihrer Nebenbuhlerin beschuldigt. Alle Indizien sprechen gegen sie, und sie hatte in beiden Fällen ein Motiv. Aber der Arzt ihrer Tante glaubt an ihre Unschuld und engagiert Poirot.

Während eines erholsamen Wochenendausflugs mit den Schwestern wird eine ehemalige Kollegin von Schwester Reg tot in ihrem Bett aufgefunden. Schwester Boniface macht sich daran, den Mörder zu entlarven.

Paris 1899: Nach dem Tod von Präsident Félix Faure droht die Republik zu zerbrechen. Da wird der Torso einer jungen Frau in einem Koffer in der Seine gefunden. Der junge, ehrgeizige Inspektor Antoine Jouin übernimmt die Ermittlungen.

Der junge Inspektor Jouin und sein korrupter Kollege Fiersi ermitteln beide in dem bizarren Mordfall. Es gelingt ihnen, das Opfer zu identifizieren: Es handelt sich um Josephine Berger, eine Informantin des Kripo-Chefs Puybaraud.
Inspektor Jouin verliebt sich in die junge Anwältin Jeanne Chauvin, die als Frau nicht praktizieren darf. Sie erklärt sich bereit, ihn bei seinen Mordermittlungen zu unterstützen.
Die Pariser Kripo, La Sûreté, muss sich beweisen und versucht fieberhaft, den Fall Joséphine Berger zu lösen. Polizeichef Lépine demonstriert eindrucksvoll seine Macht.

A gun battle between government agents and Branch Davidians leads to one of the longest stand-offs in American history; the story behind the siege features new footage and firsthand accounts from survivors, law enforcement agents and eyewitnesses.

Positive climate tipping points; a supercomputer in Cheyenne, Wyo., shows how climate systems are predicted and analysed; a Michigan coal plant makes progress in the transition to renewables; climate challenges and vulnerabilities across the U.S.
Exploring the impacts of climate change on ocean currents in Florida; electrification; nature's role in achieving net-zero emissions.

English King Richard the Lionheart builds a formidable castle along France's Seine River to assert his supremacy over his rich and strategic lands in Normandy. France's King Philip besieged the site, despite its incredible defences.
La Rochelle was the largest Protestant base in France and for Catholic King, Louis XIII, it was the last stronghold needing to be abolished.

The siege of Orleans stands as the most striking event in the Hundred Years' War. The city endured a violent and pitiless siege. For seven months, the French resisted an English army determined to conquer this strategic city on the Loire River.
A look at the siege of Alesia, a pivotal battle between the Gauls and Romans that brought thousands of soldiers to the plains of France and stands as a classic example of siege warfare.
Exploring how nuclear powers turned remote lands and marginalized communities into atomic testing grounds, from the bombing of Hiroshima to nuclear trials in Kazakhstan.

The hydrogen bomb age from Bikini to Kazakhstan, the closure of the Soviet Polygon and the broken promises of the Budapest Memorandum. Russia uses nuclear threats to redraw borders and China builds its arsenal unchecked.
Though the Rosenbergs maintain their innocence from the start, the media and public opinion seem to have condemned them from day one.
Following the stories of enslaved and eventually freed Black Americans who believed and fought for life, liberty and the pursuit of happiness.
Noch einmal werden die Highlights der Woche aus dem Pearl-Sortiment gezeigt.

Während der Kubakrise im Oktober 1962 hatte die ganze Welt Angst vor einem Atomkrieg. Ein Spion half US-Präsident Kennedy dabei, sich gegen Chruschtschow zu behaupten. Der sowjetische Offizier Oleg Penkovsky leistete hervorragende Arbeit für die CIA.

Vier Jahre nach dem Abwurf der ersten Atombombe durch die USA zündeten im Jahre 1949 auch die Sowjets eine. Das hatte so früh niemand erwartet. Doch die Sowjets hatten während des Kalten Krieges das größte Spionagenetzwerk des Jahrhunderts aufgebaut.

Verschiedene Themen der deutschen und internationalen Zeit- und Kulturgeschichte werden nachgezeichnet. Mit Expertengesprächen und szenischen Nacherzählungen werden dabei Vorkommnisse aus jüngerer und älterer Geschichte neu zum Leben erweckt.

Im Sommer 1945 sind große Teile Japans zerstört. Täglich sterben zahllose Zivilisten. Trotzdem weigert sich die Führung zu kapitulieren. Die US-Armee bereitet eine Invasion vor, zögert aber noch. Zuerst soll die Insel Okinawa erobert werden.

Queen Elizabeth war 13, als England in den Krieg mit Nazideutschland trat. Von den Eltern getrennt, machte sie britischen Kindern Mut. Die Schrecken des Krieges prägen ihr Leben laut Experten für das Königshaus bis heute.

Die Reihe beleuchtet die besonderen Fähigkeiten und die enge Verbindung zwischen Mensch und Hund. Forschungen und Beobachtungen zeigen Herkunft, Sinne, Verhalten und die erstaunliche Physiologie verschiedener Hunderassen.

Hunde haben eine ausgeprägte emotionale Bindung zum Menschen und ihre außergewöhnlichen Sinne können ihre Besitzer im Alltag unterstützen. Das erklärt auch, wieso und auf welche Weise gerade der Hund ein so gewichtiger Teil im Leben der Menschen ist.

Sie sind die besten Freunde des Menschen seit Tausenden von Jahren - Aber wie viel weiß der Mensch wirklich über den Hund? Gezeigt werden die einzigartigen Eigenschaften von Hunden, ihre Physiologie sowie ihre emotionale Bindung zum Menschen.

The BBC's Europe editor, Katya Adler, travels to Croatia, Bosnia, and Albania. Thirty years since the Yugoslav wars of independence, she discovers a beautiful region undergoing rapid change.
Simon Reeve travels three thousand miles across Mongolia's deserts and mountains, searching for elusive snow leopards and meeting nomadic people who hunt with golden eagles.
Jools Holland brings together hot, legendary and undiscovered artists for live studio performances, interviews and musical magic.

When teenager Priscilla Beaulieu meets Elvis Presley at a party, the man who's already a meteoric rock 'n' roll superstar becomes someone entirely unexpected in private moments: a thrilling crush, an ally in loneliness, and a gentle best friend.
Fiona Bruce presents an hour of topical debate.
Stars Vernon Kay, Paul Eastwood and Glenn Ward. Following a group of young people around America as they go to various raves, nightclubs, events and other parties.
The stories of three women: a researcher, a prostitute and a part-time switchboard operator.
A young trapper leads a group of pioneers through unexplored territory.
A pearl necklace belonging to the wealthy Countessa Ferenzi is involved in several unexplainable incidents.
Deep in debt, the Honourable James Mallory plots to murder his cousin, Lord Rollestone, so he can claim the earldom and inheritance.
Founder of Talking Pictures TV and one half of the Footage Detectives, Noel Cronin, shares shows and films not to be missed throughout October.
Lucy designs a vault in an attempt to get Jack Benny's account.
Holmes sets out to prove that a famous escape artist is not a murderer.
A cavalry major is accused of being a traitor because of his sympathetic attitude toward the Indians.
A farmer's son becomes a princess's personal bodyguard to thwart the attacks of the evil Pendragon, Master of Demons.
Batman, Robin and Batgirl match wits with glamorous, thieving Minerva, owner of a mineral spa.
Ant-humanoids from outer space kidnap young Earth females who are fearful of atomic destruction in order to interbreed and save their species from extinction.
Originally shot on 35mm Eastmancolor film stock, a 1960s look at a little-seen underground world. Revealing the labyrinth of London sewers, an ever-expanding cave of silver and the GPO.
Angie, Ida and Robert travel to Yorkshire, but the journey is not without its share of trouble. Secretary Edith Parfitt gets worried.
Walter and Leslie sneak off to the pub for a Sunday drink, to Ruth and Ada's disapproval.
Evil Squire Partridge returns for a magnetic metal that can control world communications.

Richter and his keen new SS aide move to quell a British propaganda campaign, leading to the arrest of an innocent man.
Originally shot on 1962 35mm film stock and in Eastmancolor, a look at Hadrian's Wall in Northumberland in northeast England. Also, with a look at a more detailed examination of the Berlin Wall.
After using up funds from their first bank robbery, a pair of amateurs plan another.
Following Billy Fox, an outwardly retired Covent Garden market porter living in Clapham with his family, who have gangland connections in London's East End.

Tough New York narcotics detective 'Popeye' Doyle moves to Marseilles in his obsessive pursuit of his old adversary, the drug dealer Charnier. This suspenseful sequel moves away from the straight action of its predecessor to explore Doyle's complex character more fully.
A TOTP-style TV show for Heritage Artists based on the Heritage Chart which is voted on in over 80 countries. Songs you love from popular artists, live and on video with the odd interview.
While quarantining at her family's lake house during the pandemic, Parker and her best friend are threatened by an unexpected visitor.

A party of high school students settle in a woodland cabin for the weekend. When they find and read a copy of 'The Book of the Dead', a tome that raises not just demons outside the walls but within, they become demonically possessed with murderous desires.

Fighting for survival at an isolated fishing outpost, Eva and her crew are cursed after making the choice to not help a sinking ship off the coast. Facing the consequences, a darkness consumes them all, creating chaos and death at every turn.
Science teacher Hank's life changes when he reconnects with his first love and suspects a new student is his daughter, all while facing an alien threat in their town.

A new girl at an LA high school finds it difficult to make friends, and teams up with three fellow outcasts known as the Bitches of Eastwick. However, her telekinetic powers turn the supernatural games in which the three have been dabbling, into something much more sinister.

In the 1930s Chicago, groundbreaking scientist Dr. Euphronious brings a murdered young woman back to life to be a companion for Frankenstein's monster. What happens next is beyond what either of them could ever have imagined.

Plagued by a violent and recurring nightmare, a college student heads home to track down the one person who might be able to break the cycle of death and save her family from the grisly demise that inevitably awaits them all.

A new bride is left under the care of friends when her husband travels to Transylvania for a meeting with Count Orlok. Plagued by horrific visions and an increasing sense of dread, she soon encounters an evil force that's far beyond her control.

Still living in quarantine due to the rage virus, a survivor decides to venture into the dark heart of the mainland. He soon discovers a mutation that has spread to not only the infected, but other survivors as well.

When Mike's 11-year-old sister sneaks out to reconnect with Freddy, Bonnie, Chica and Foxy, she sets into motion a terrifying series of events that reveal dark secrets about the true origin of Freddy's.

Bad dreams haunt 15-year-old Gwen as she receives calls from the black phone and sees disturbing visions of three boys being stalked at a winter camp. With help from her brother, she must now confront a killer who's grown even more powerful in death.

At a remote forest cabin, five friends discover a Book of the Dead and unwittingly summon an ancient demon. The malevolent entity possesses each person in succession, until only one is left intact to fight for survival.

A feature-length spin-off from the TV series, the Thornberry family - led by natural history film-maker Colonel Radcliffe Thornberry - head to the deepest Africa. Once there, daughter Eliza - after meeting a shaman - can talk to the animals, a skill that stands her in good stead to foil a dastardly plot by poachers to kill a herd of elephants for their ivory.

A life-saving surgery fuses together a police officer and his faithful police dog -- and Dog Man is born. Learning to embrace his new identity, Dog Man must stop feline supervillain Petey the Cat from cloning himself and going on a crime spree.
Stranded in the wilderness, a mule deer and a domesticated bear try to make their way back to the safety of a town preserve before a hunter catches them.
Music and lights bring magic to life. From `Sing' to `The Bad Guys 2', enjoy animated animal adventures the whole family will love.

Mr Peabody, the most accomplished canine in the world, and his boy, Sherman, use a time machine called the Wabac to embark on outrageous adventures. However, when Sherman takes the Wabac without permission to impress his friend Penny, he accidentally rips a hole in the universe and causes havoc with world history. It's up to Mr Peabody to mount a rescue and prevent the past, present and future from being permanently altered. A DreamWorks animation.

Po might just be the laziest, clumsiest panda in the Valley of Peace, but he secretly dreams of becoming a kung fu legend. When the villainous snow leopard Tai Lung threatens Po's homeland, the hapless panda is chosen to fulfil an ancient prophecy and defend the Valley from attack. Training under Master Shifu, Po embarks on an epic high-kicking adventure as he sets out to thwart Tai Lung's evil plans. A DreamWorks animation.
A panda must unlock the secrets of his past in order to defeat a formidable villain who plans to wipe out kung fu and conquer China.
After reuniting with his long-lost father, Po must train a village of clumsy pandas to help him defeat a supernatural warrior who becomes stronger with each battle.

An inept swashbuckler decides to make an attempt to win the Pirate of the Year Award, and beat his rivals Black Bellamy and Cutlass Liz in a race to plunder the most booty. His journey takes him to Victorian London where the Pirate Captain must choose between winning Pirate of the Year, or helping his crew.

Bitten by a radioactive spider, teenager Miles Morales suddenly develops mysterious powers that transform him into Spider-Man. He must now use his newfound skills to battle the evil Kingpin, a hulking madman who can open portals to other universes.

Story of the chase for a giant rabbit terrorising a town's allotments and vegetable patches days before the annual vegetable-growing competition. As Wallace and his trusty companion are called into action with their pest control business, a dastardly Lord Victor Quartermaine competes to capture the Were-Rabbit and win the heart of a beautiful lady.
On a mission to find a new master to serve, three Minions meet Scarlet Overkill, the world's first female super-villain.

A spoiled but lonely pet rat gets flushed down the toilet and finds himself stranded in London's sewer underworld. A savvy scavenger helps him evade frog assassins, but his attempts to help escalate the conflict put them both in deadly danger.
A domesticated terrier and his unruly canine pal encounter a rebellious bunny and his gang of abandoned pets.
The film explores the bonds between pets and the families that love them, and answers the question: What are your pets doing when you’re not at home?
SpongeBob goes on a quest to discover a stolen recipe that takes him to our world, where he tangles with a pirate.
After becoming lost in the Louisiana swamplands, a group of holidaymakers must fight for their lives against a rampaging hippo on the loose.
A CIA agent comes up against a duplicitous American government during his quest to nab a Colombian drug lord.

Louis Bloom finds himself falling head first in to the shady world of crime journalism. He quickly develops a taste for the profession and discovers that he has got both the business acumen and a strong enough stomach to fend off his rivals.
In a dystopian future America, a team of military-embedded journalists races against time to reach Washington, D.C., before rebel factions descend upon the White House.

London, 1971: Terry Leather's ex-girlfriend Martine turns up with a tempting proposition. A bank's alarm is scheduled to be turned off for a week, so Terry and his team tunnel through to the vault from a neighbouring property.

John and Jane Smith are a typical suburban couple first seen undergoing marriage counselling to try and get the spark back in their relationship. What neither of them knows is that the other is a highly skilled assassin until, separately, they get a call for their next job. Accidentally double-booked, they discover the truth about each other's secret existence, and are in danger not just from their bosses, but each other.

When his beloved wife, Kathryn, is suspected of betraying the nation, intelligence agent George Woodhouse faces the ultimate test -- loyalty to his marriage or his country.

A divorced train commuter passes the house she used to live in with her husband every day. To distract herself she creates a fictional perfect world for her former neighbours in her head. This is ruined when one of the neighbours goes missing.
He balances books by day and bodies by night. A maths savant hiding behind a CPA desk, Christian Wolff crunches numbers for cartels and killers - until one error adds him to the equation.

Jake Green is a hotshot gambler, long on audacity and short on common sense. Jake served seven years in jail for a crime he didn't commit after taking the rap for mean crime boss Dorothy Macha. Upon his release he takes on Macha in a private casino game, causes humiliation, and wins. While Macha puts out an order on Jake's life, Jake meets brothers Avi and Zach who protect him and plot to take Macha down.
A chronicle of the crimes of Ted Bundy, from the perspective of his longtime girlfriend, who refused to believe the truth about him for years.

Demonised as the Wicked Witch of the West, Elphaba lives in exile, while Glinda resides at the palace in Emerald City. As an angry mob rises against the Wicked Witch, she'll need to reunite with Glinda to transform herself, and all of Oz, for good.

Grown-up Peter Pan has to return to Neverland to rediscover his true identity in order to rescue his children from the clutches of the evil Captain Hook. Peter has grown up into a workaholic executive but takes time off for a holiday in London. Once there, his children are kidnapped by Hook, and Peter must throw off his corporate image and go back to Neverland to save his children.

When young adventurer Sean Anderson receives a coded distress signal from an uncharted island, he sets out to find it and rescue its lone inhabitant before seismic shockwaves force the island under the sea and bury its treasures forever.

Creepy fairy tale following the fortunes of a young orphan who becomes embroiled in a supernatural adventure. Brought up on his kindly grandmother's scary stories about witches, he stumbles on a real coven while on holiday. Overhearing their plans to capture all the children in Britain, he sets out to stop them, remaining undeterred throughout - even when he has been turned into a mouse.
A young farmhand gets swept into the realm of legend when he must defend his land from a seemingly unstoppable force of giant warriors.

Unknown to humans, all-out war between cats and dogs has raged since the beginning of time. Now the cats face defeat if scientist Professor Brody can perfect a formula that will make all humans non-allergic to dogs. The cats' leader, Mr Tinkles, plans to steal the serum, but first he must get past fearless dog agent Lou who, thanks to a mistake in recruitment, guards the Brody family.
The canine and feline species join forces to thwart the evil plans of a rogue cat who dreams of global domination.

A mysterious portal pulls four misfits into the Overworld, a bizarre, cubic wonderland that thrives on imagination. To get back home, they'll have to master the terrain while embarking on a magical quest with an unexpected crafter named Steve.

Spoof spy caper with the eponymous, blundering hero attempting to recover the crown jewels and save Britain from an evil mastermind when all the other agents are killed. Promoted from lowly pen pusher to super spy, Johnny English is baffled when clues lead to respected entrepreneur Pascal Sauvage, but could the enigmatic Lorna hold the key to the mystery?

Mr Bean has somehow managed to get a job as a security guard. His latest assignment finds him travelling to America as an art expert, looking after the famous 'Whistler's Mother' painting as it is transported from Britain to a posh new Los Angeles museum. The catch is that Bean is no art expert and his trip was a ploy by his British employers to get rid of him. Unfortunately, no one has warned the Americans about Mr Bean.

Mr Bean is going on holiday to the south of France, looking for a quiet and sunny trip in the Riviera. However, his trip doesn't go as smoothly as he expected when he has to face a series of misunderstandings and totally unfortunate coincidences. Eventually, Mr Bean will end up spoiling the last film of the snobbish director Carson Clay and appearing by accident at the Cannes Film Festival.
A haphazard spy returns to MI-7 after years in a Tibetan monastery honing his Zen skills. Armed with gizmos, gadgets and chaotic luck he takes on a global ring of assassins.

A New York couple go to an orphanage to adopt a brother for their only son, but instead come away with a little mouse. On arrival at his new home, the diminutive rodent receives a lukewarm welcome by the boy - and an even frostier reception from the pet cat. Featuring a mixture of live action and animation.

Sequel to the children's story about the adventures of a small mouse, blending live action and computer-animated characters. The eponymous hero befriends a tiny bird wounded by a sinister falcon, but he must enlist the help of the dreaded family cat if he is to protect his new-found friend.
Old rivalries and new adversaries await Daniel and Mr Miyagi as they travel to Okinawa to visit Miyagi's ailing father.

A boy trained in the martial arts is alienated from his mentor just when he needs to prepare for a showdown with his arch-enemy. Instead, he turns to a Vietnam vet who teaches him how to fight dirty - a strategy the youth comes to realise is a mistake.

Henry Hill knows only too well that he must put the Mob's interests before everything, even his family, but when the good times turn sour, his loyalties dissolve in the face of greater rewards. Faced with a terrible retribution, Hill can see only one way to get out alive.

After getting a green card in exchange for assassinating a Cuban government official, Tony Montana stakes a claim on the drug trade in Miami. Viciously murdering anyone who stands in his way, Tony eventually becomes the biggest drug lord in the state, controlling nearly all the cocaine that comes through Miami. But increased pressure from the police, wars with Colombian drug cartels and his own drug-fuelled paranoia serve to fuel the flames of his eventual downfall.
A man's neutrality during the American Civil War is tested by his daughter's marriage and his son's capture by Union forces.

In 2274, computers rule a hermetically sealed city housing the survivors of a holocaust that has decimated the earth. Life is hedonistic and happy for the city's inhabitants; unfortunately they must be terminated when they reach 30. When Logan 5, a trained hunter for the system, grows intrigued by a beautiful young woman, he is forced to question the fundamental principles of his society and decides he must flee.

Filmmaker Terri Flores is travelling deep in the Amazon jungle looking for a forgotten tribe. Terri and her crew, which includes an anthropologist and a cameraman, come across Paul, who is stranded on the riverbank. He offers to help them find the tribe, but his secretive behaviour puts everyone on edge. They realise too late that he's using them to find a legendary anaconda that's worth a fortune, if they can catch it.

Scary chiller about a coastal community plagued by a killer shark. With the summer tourist season at hand, the mayor is keen to keep the first attack hushed up. However, when an expert claims that the attacks are the work of a giant great white shark, there is only one solution - to kill the monster fish before it can feed again.

Another great white shark arrives to terrorise the holiday resort of Amity Island. Having recovered from the grisly events of four years ago, the island is once again packed with tourists. Families are sailing in the bay and swimming off the beach, but when two divers and a water-skier go missing, the local police chief fears that he is about to relive his greatest nightmare.

Second sequel to Steven Spielberg's 1970s blockbuster transports the action from Amity Island to a new undersea kingdom attraction in a Florida theme park. The capture of a baby great white shark is big news and brings crowds to the park - until its mother arrives on the scene.

A ten-year-old boy befriends and shelters a gentle alien creature who has been stranded on Earth. The fate of humanity is at stake when two races of robots, the good Autobots and the villainous Decepticons, bring their war to Earth. Emily Kennedy, a young housekeeper, is content with her life until an unexpected death throws her situation into turmoil. However, when a young man inherits a farm estate, Emily is given a new chance at life.

Rich, independent and kind-spirited, Emma Woodhouse delights in matchmaking those around her. Zwei Spitzenköche begeben sich auf einen Roadtrip durch Norditalien. Auf dem Weg zur Pizza-WM in Parma suchen sie nach besten Zutaten und neuen Techniken - immer mit Humor, Leidenschaft und einem Ziel: die perfekte Pizza.

Jedes Jahr kommen neue Produkte auf den Markt. Detlef Steves und seine Frau Nicole sowie weitere wechselnde Familien nehmen Erfindungen aus aller Welt genau unter die Lupe. Dabei werden das Design, der Nutzwert und der Preis bewertet.

Dalton findet im Dezember 2004 die Leiche seiner Mutter im Bett. Daneben liegen Scheidungspapiere. Jennifer und Bart Corbin galten bis dahin als Vorzeigepärchen in ihrer Stadt. Bart gerät durch einen alten Fall ins Visier der Ermittlungen.
Zwei Hunde als Zeugen eines Mordes sind die ganze Hoffnung für die Polizei, den Täter zu entlarven. Ein Mörder glaubt, er habe das ultimative Verbrechen begangen, unterschätzt jedoch die Forensik.
Old debts come due and money trumps all as desire, jealousy and the pursuit of power collide at Greater Hope.
A basketball player in his early 20s must deal with the pressures of sudden stardom.
A couple, Akpan and Oduma, travel from their village to Lagos in search of wealth.
Join the musical adventures of Kibena, Kiduchu, Koba and Baraka, who use their brains to solve problems big and small in Kokotoa Village.
Akili goes on exciting adventures through Lala Land: a magical land filled with talking animals.
Follows four old university friends who share a unique relationship - they hate being together but also cannot do well without each other. How will they find a middle ground?
Featuring interviews with newsmakers, analysts, American and African government officials and everyday citizens presenting a variety of opinions on issues affecting the African continent.
Justin's mother tries to force him to marry her friend's daughter, however he ends up falling in love with a blind girl from the village, whom his mother forbids.
An international call-in talk show where guests discuss topics of special interest to Africans, including politics, economic development, press freedom, health, social issues and conflict resolution.
A selection of top Afrobeat tracks of the moment on Vox Africa.
A comedy series that dramatizes the everyday experiences in a hospital.
A man with amnesia who is dumped at a hospital by strangers grows very close to his doctor, however soon after he moves into her home their relationship changes dramatically.

A man in his fifties is in love with a supermodel his daughter's age, who doesn't accept her father's decision. Scared of losing her place in her father's estate, she creates a storm that could shatter the entire empire.
One to one interviews with celebrities from around the world.
Monique and her friends know what they want from their men and will do anything to please and keep them. However, getting their men to appreciate them is a different story.

Voights Einheit kämpft noch immer mit dem Tod von Olinsky. Als eine Jugendliche aus einer wohlhabenden Familie entführt wird, nimmt das Team die Ermittlungen auf. Die Ermittler entdecken bald, dass das Mädchen eine Affäre mit einem der Entführer hat.

Burgess nimmt während ihrer Schicht einen Zivilisten in ihrem Wagen. Nachdem das junge Mädchen aus dem Auto verschwindet, steht sie vor einer schwierigen Entscheidung. Soll sie dem Rat von Voight oder dem einer potenziellen neuen Verbündeten folgen?

Tim Albrecht arbeitet seit Kurzem als Praktikant bei dem Makler Marco von Reeken. Bisher durfte er nur telefonisch Kontakt zu den Kunden haben. Nun darf er die erste Besichtigung selbst durchführen. Natürlich bleibt der Chef an seiner Seite.

Maklerin Claudia trifft auf die amtierende Miss Bremen Denise Diek, die eine neue Wohnung sucht. So sehr sich die Maklerin auch über die Kundin freut, so anstrengend ist ihre Begleitung. An allem gibt es etwas auszusetzen.

Der Makler Axel Hartmann soll sich um den Verkauf einer Millionenvilla kümmern. Um die Sache zu beschleunigen, hat er mehrere Interessenten gleichzeitig eingeladen. Doch diese sind nicht begeistert davon, dass sie keinen exklusiven Zugang bekommen.

Heiko Schäfer wird von seiner Frau verlassen, weil er einen Treuetest nicht besteht. Doch er hat seine Frau nie betrogen. Ihm wird bewusst, dass die Treuetestagentur ein mieses Spiel spielt und Beziehungen der Kunden riskiert.

Wie auch Arno Peeck suchen sich jedes Jahr mehr als 25.000 deutsche Männer eine Frau im Ausland. Arno hat seine wesentlich jüngere Frau in der Ukraine gefunden. Doch die Standesbeamtin will ihm die Eheschließung verweigern.

Die Eheleute Sabine und Peter Hirmer wollen die Kreditkosten für ihr geerbtes Einfamilienhaus etwas senken, indem sie die obere Etage an ein junges Pärchen vermieten. Allerdings verweigert dieses nach seinem Einzug jegliche Zahlungen.

Sabine Schröder behaupte, Mitautorin eines Mode-Ratgebers zu sein, und fordert eine horrende Summe Schadensersatz von ihrer ehemals besten Freundin und Co-Autorin Anke Siebrecht. Doch eine Zahlung würde den Laden von Anke und ihrem Mann in den Ruin stürzen. Einziger Ausweg ist ein Vergleich, bei dem Sabine zur Teilhaberin gemacht wird. Damit haben sich die Siebrechts allerdings den Teufel ins Geschäft geholt, den sie nun nicht mehr loswerden.

Um Rechtslagen darzustellen, wird in jeder Folge ein Streitfall vorgestellt, der durch einen Rechtsanwalt kommentiert wird. Die jeweiligen Alltagssituationen werden von Laiendarstellern nach einem genauen Drehbuch gespielt.

Die 17-jährige Katinka wird zum Schrecken ihrer Eltern Matthias und Ilona Opfer einer Entführung. Nach ihrer Befreiung verteidigt Katinka jedoch ihre Geiselnehmer und behauptet, in den Bruder des Verbrechers verliebt zu sein.

Fünf Frauen treten an fünf aufeinanderfolgenden Tagen gegeneinander an, um die Frau mit dem besten Stil zu werden. Am Montag gibt es die Aufgabe und ein Budget. Jede Frau hat an einem der Wochentage dann die Chance, in vier Stunden für ein bestimmtes Event ihr Outfit zu gestalten. Die anderen Frauen bewerten zusammen mit Star-Designer Guido Maria Kretschmer das Ergebnis und geben ihre Punkte ab. Am Ende der Woche wird die "Shopping Queen" gekürt.

Fünf Kandidatinnen treten an, um die Frau mit dem besten Stil zu werden. Am Anfang der jeweiligen Woche werden die Aufgabe und das Budget bekanntgegeben. Jede der Teilnehmerinnen hat vier Stunden Zeit. Dieses Mal ist Irina an der Reihe.

Fünf Kandidatinnen treten an, um die Frau mit dem besten Stil zu werden. Am Anfang der jeweiligen Woche werden die Aufgabe und das Budget bekanntgegeben. Jede der Teilnehmerinnen hat vier Stunden Zeit. Dieses Mal ist Kera an der Reihe.

Immer auf der linken Spur, mit "Bleifuß" auf dem Gaspedal und den Blinker nonstop im Einsatz - Autobahnraser sind auf Deutschlands Straßen zum alltäglichen Bild geworden - und zur Bedrohung für verantwortungsbewusste Verkehrsteilnehmer. Die Doku-Soap "Schneller als die Polizei erlaubt" befasst sich mit diesem Problem. Zusammen mit den ProViDa-Teams der Polizei geht die Sendung auf die Jagd nach den Verkehrsrowdys.

Polizeibeamte befassen sich mit Verkehrssündern auf Deutschlands Straßen. Sie ziehen die Verkehrssünder, die andere gefährden, heraus. Es geht um einen Fahrer und die Beifahrerin, die sich nah gekommen sind - und das während der Fahrt.

Polizeibeamte befassen sich mit Verkehrssündern auf Deutschlands Straßen. Sie ziehen die Verkehrssünder, die andere gefährden, heraus. In dieser Folge geht es um einen Fahrzeugführer, der unter Wildereiverdacht gerät.

Zusammen mit der Polizei und modernster Technik werden Autobahnraser geschnappt. Die PKW und Motorräder der Polizei sind mit Messgeräten ausgerüstet und können so die Durchschnittsgeschwindigkeit eines Fahrzeuges bestimmen.

Die Polizei jagt die Raserszene. Sie sind mit dem Bleifuß auf dem Gaspedal unterwegs und haben Lichthupe sowie den Blinker nonstop im Einsatz. Die Streifenwagen jagen hinterher und ein ertappter Musiker vergreift sich prompt im Ton.

Die Opfer von Kristen Gilbert hatten keine Ahnung, dass sie ihr nicht trauen konnten. Im Jahr 1995 häuften sich die Todesfälle im VA Medical Center, viele erlitten einen Herzstillstand. Niemand ahnte, dass Kristen die Patienten tötete. Die Krankenschwester, die jeder für fürsorglich hielt, war in Wirklichkeit gefährlich. Doch welches Motiv hatte Kristen?

Es ist der 15. Juni 2007, ein ruhiger Tag in der Polizeizentrale in Arkansas, doch um 21:15 Uhr geht ein Notruf ein. Der örtliche Rancher Bob Devor meldet einen Einbruch. Nicht nur seine Waffen sind verschwunden, sondern auch seine Frau Pauline. Kurz bevor die Polizei eintrifft, entdeckt Bob Einschusslöcher.

Kurz vor 21:30 Uhr wählte die 35-jährige Eileen Leone den Notruf und meldete einen Einbruch, bei dem ihr Freund Darius attackiert wurde. Sie war hysterisch und kaum zu beruhigen. Nachdem die Polizei am Tatort angekommen ist, entdecken sie, dass Darius Smith noch lebt und bringen ihn in ein Krankenhaus. Doch wer hat ihm das angetan? Je mehr die Ermittler herausfinden, desto mehr zweifeln sie an einer willkürlichen Tat …

Cindy und Michael sind ein typisches Kleinstadtpaar. Religiös und einander treu ergeben. Doch dann wird der ewige Bund durch eine schreckliche Gewalttat jäh beendet: Am 18. Februar 2015 geht ein Notruf bei der Polizei ein: Es ist Cindy Reese, die in ihrem verwüsteten Zuhause verzweifelt nach ihrem Mann sucht. Was zunächst nach einem Überfall aussieht, entpuppt sich schnell als Mord. Und dann gerät ein Pfarrer in den Mittelpunkt der Ermittlungen.
